title: Bodycam Shows Tough Guy Trying to Fight 5 Police Officers: ‘Roided Out’
description:
Bodycam footage shows the moments surrounding the arrest of a Nevada man who offered to go “toe-to-toe” with any of the five officers who confronted him. Reno authorities responded to Christopher Sheahan’s apartment after neighbors said he was yelling. What happened next set off Sheahan. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
